help:
Color conversion, perceptual palettes, and WCAG contrast tools

Usage: chromap [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  inspect    Show conversions and measurements
  convert    Convert one color to the global --format
  adjust     Adjust a color
  mix        Mix two colors
  gradient   Generate an inclusive gradient
  palette    Generate a harmony or scale
  contrast   Measure, select, or repair contrast
  distance   Measure OKLab and sRGB distances
  composite  Alpha-composite foreground over background
  average    Compute an alpha-aware average
  dominant   Cluster supplied colors into representative swatches
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --format <FORMAT>
          Color representation used by color-emitting commands
          
          [default: hex]
          [possible values: hex, rgb, hsl, hsv, cmyk, oklab, oklch]

      --json
          Emit structured JSON

      --plain
          Emit stable text without ANSI decoration

      --color <COLOR_OUTPUT>
          Control ANSI color swatches in human-readable output

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Use color only when stdout is an interactive, color-capable terminal
          - always: Emit ANSI color even when stdout is redirected
          - never:  Never emit ANSI color
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

contrast_help:
Measure, select, or repair contrast

Usage: chromap contrast [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  ratio        Measure ratio and WCAG thresholds
  pick         Pick the highest-contrast candidate
  black-white  Choose black or white
  ensure       Change only foreground lightness until a target is met

Generate a harmony or scale

Usage: chromap palette [OPTIONS] <COLOR>

Arguments:
  <COLOR>
          

Options:
  -k, --kind <KIND>
          [default: neighbors]
          [possible values: neighbors, lightness, analogous-scale, hue-wheel, golden, tints, shades, tones, complementary, analogous, split-complementary, triadic, square, tetradic]

  -c, --count <COUNT>
          [default: 7]

      --lightness-span <LIGHTNESS_SPAN>
          [default: 0.4]

      --hue-span <HUE_SPAN>
          [default: 60]

      --min-lightness <MIN_LIGHTNESS>
          [default: 0.1]

      --max-lightness <MAX_LIGHTNESS>
          [default: 0.9]

      --css-prefix <CSS_PREFIX>
          

      --png <PATH>
          Write a checkerboard-backed PNG preview; use - for binary stdout

      --dry-run
          Validate and encode the PNG without writing it

  -f, --force
          Replace an existing PNG file
